lua: local p,b=PREVIEW_PY,PREVIEW.before; assert(not settings.bar.docked and not settings.bar.snap and not settings.bar.auto_width, 'Free placement did not disable docking, snapping and automatic width'); assert(not settings.bar.locked, 'Free placement did not unlock moving and resizing'); assert(p.window_x('##momentum_bar')==b.x and p.window_y('##momentum_bar')==b.y and p.window_width('##momentum_bar')==b.width and p.window_height('##momentum_bar')==b.height, 'Free placement jumped or changed the rendered size'); settings.window.open=false
assert(settings.bar.y<400 and not settings.bar.docked, 'Free bar did not drag'); PREVIEW.free_width=PREVIEW_PY.window_width('##momentum_bar')

assert(settings.bar.width==PREVIEW.free_width+80 and PREVIEW_PY.window_width('##momentum_bar')==settings.bar.width, 'Free width resize did not follow its edge'); PREVIEW.free_height=PREVIEW_PY.window_height('##momentum_bar')
assert(settings.bar.height==PREVIEW.free_height+10 and PREVIEW_PY.window_height('##momentum_bar')==settings.bar.height, 'Free height resize did not follow its edge')
